basic_info.description: Hidden sanctuary in Crocker Amazon where suburban calm meets city life. This private retreat offers a rare blend of space, serenity, and style. Step through the enclosed portico into a sunlit living room with vaulted ceilings, skylight, and large windows framing lush greenery. The remodeled chef's kitchen features an 8-ft island, Bosch appliances, quartz counters, terrazzo floors, and a picture window with downtown and Sutro Tower views. The backyard is perfect for entertaining with a fire pit, greenhouse, and garden. Upstairs includes a guest room with stunning views, spa-like bath with soaking tub and steam shower, and a vaulted primary suite with dual closets and en-suite bath. The lower level offers a private bedroom with a full bathroom and garden accessideal for guests or in-laws. Owned solar system included. 1-car parking, extra storage, and a peaceful, family-friendly location close to parks, shopping, and transit. A true San Francisco retreat.
